cases.K01: case: a, B, c (ESLint and Oxlint put capitals first; Biome interleaves A a B b)
cases.K02: numbers inside names: a10, a2, a1 (only Biome is natural)
cases.K05: numeric and named keys mixed: b, 2, a, 1
cases.K07: a computed [identifier] key between named keys: b, [key], a
cases.K09: a computed template key between named keys: c, [`x${y}`], b, a
cases.K10: a spread in the middle: b, a, ...rest, d, c
cases.K13: a line comment above each of two keys
cases.K14: a JSDoc block above each of two keys
cases.K15: a trailing // comment after each comma
cases.K16: section comments that head groups of keys (// Colours, // Sizes)
cases.K19: a setter before its getter, then a plain key
cases.K22b: duplicate keys a twice among others (JavaScript)
cases.K24: a TypeScript type literal (not an object literal)
cases.K25: a TypeScript interface (not an object literal)
cases.K26: a destructuring pattern (not an object literal)
cases.K30b: a style object with marginTop before margin
cases.K30c: a style object with borderColor before border
cases.K33: a spread and one key (two members)
cases.K34: non-ASCII and case: é, z, Z
cases.K35: names that differ only by case: a, A
cases.K37: a computed template key without expressions: [`b`], a
cases.K38: a block comment before the first key, on the line of {
cases.K39: a block comment after the last key
cases.K45: a computed key with groups of unsorted keys on both sides
cases.K46: a trailing comment on one key and a leading comment on the next
cases.K47: B, _, a, "-", "0": punctuation and digits against letters
cases.K48: item2, item10, item1, Item3: natural numbers with case
cases.K52: duplicate keys in a 23-key object, where Oxlint's unstable sort swaps them (JavaScript)
cases.K50: a trailing // comment on a key that moves last, with } on the same line
cases.K51: a trailing // comment on a key that moves last, the object's trailing comma after the last key
cases.B01: side-effecting values: { b: note('b'), a: note('a') }
cases.B03: ++ in values: { b: i++, a: i++ }
cases.B04: a getter with side effects read twice: { second: src.next, first: src.next }
cases.B05: a spread that overrides, keys on both sides: { size, ...defaults, color, align }
cases.B06: duplicate keys, the later wins: { a: 1, b: 2, a: 3 }
cases.B06b: duplicate keys among others: { z, a: 1, c, a: 3, b }
cases.B06c: duplicate keys in a 23-key object: which value wins after the fix
cases.B09: a for-in first match over route prefixes
cases.B10: a package exports-style condition map, first match wins
cases.B12: integer-like keys enumerate first, in numeric order, wherever they're written
cases.B13: __proto__ in the middle of an object
cases.B18: a getter that reads keys declared after it
cases.B20: a sha256 of JSON.stringify (a cache key)
cases.I01: TanStack Query-style mutation options: onError reads the context onMutate returns
cases.I02: TanStack Router-style route options: head and component read the loader's data
cases.I03: a store whose render reads the state's type
cases.I04: control: the loader takes no parameters, so it isn't context-sensitive
cases.I05: control: the later callback's parameter is annotated
